question: Do late orders have lower ratings in March 2018?

payload.reason: Late orders averaged -1 rating points relative to on-time orders among reviewed orders.

evidence.methodology: Left join by unique order ID. Purchase-time cohort; late means actual > promised. Each order score is the mean of its non-null effective reviews. Low rating means order score <= 2.
limitations: Descriptive association, not a causal effect.
Missing delivery dates form an unclassified cohort; missing reviews are excluded from rating denominators.
Effective delivery dates and review scores may include modeled incident adjustments.
Review respondents may differ from orders without reviews.
